cluster_label: Chairman of the National Board of Revenue
title: Administrative Signatory Authority
summary: The Chairman of the NBR serves as the formal signatory for legal and administrative instruments. This role remains static across various documents, representing the official validation of the Board's orders.

evolution.role: Consistent role as the authorized signatory for NBR orders.

timeline.change: Standardized signature format for NBR orders.
